verdict.rationale: Highnote is driven through a documented public GraphQL API. Its docs cover the API with an interactive code explorer, mutations such as rotateNotificationTargetSigningKey and adding notes to accounts, a production-like test environment, and an official Node.js SDK that wraps the API. Programmatic card issuance and the full payment lifecycle are explicitly API-available, and the OpenAPI 404s are expected for a GraphQL API rather than a contradiction. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of API usage, evidence of a published machine-readable schema (the Node SDK is also still beta).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Build faster with GraphQL API, interactive code explorer, PCI-compliant SDKs, and real-time web hooks designed for modern development.
This guide provides an overview of issuing a financial account and virtual card product using the Highnote API.
The full payment lifecycle is available via API.
One key, one endpoint, and a test environment that behaves like production.
the official `@highnote-oss/nodejs-sdk` (currently in beta) wraps the Highnote API in typed, resource-oriented methods
